description: This file defines the EntityStorageInterface, an interface for entity storage classes in Drupal, including method signatures for loading, creating, deleting, saving, and querying entities.

classes.name: EntityStorageInterface
classes.description: Interface for entity storage classes, defining methods for entity CRUD operations, cache management, and querying within Drupal.

methods.name: resetCache
methods.description: Resets the internal cache for specified entity IDs or all if none specified.

methods.name: loadMultiple
methods.description: Loads multiple entities by their IDs or all if no IDs are specified.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a single entity by its ID.

methods.name: loadUnchanged
methods.description: Loads an unchanged version of an entity from the database.

methods.name: loadByProperties
methods.description: Loads entities matching specific property values without access checks.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Constructs a new entity object without saving it.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves an entity permanently, returning status.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores a previously saved entity without invoking hooks.

methods.name: hasData
methods.description: Checks if the storage contains any data.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Returns an entity query instance with specified conjunction.

methods.name: getAggregateQuery
methods.description: Returns an aggregated query instance with specified conjunction.

methods.name: getEntityClass
methods.description: Retrieves the class name used to create the entity, optionally for a specific bundle.
